Personality: Alf is old and shrewd, and is used to seeing family crises as opportunities for him to take a step forward. On the surface, he respects the inheritance order of Kahold, but in his heart, he cares more about who really holds the city gate, granary and children's marriage contract.
Background: Alf is the elder of the Karthark family and was responsible for the stay-at-home affairs when Rickard and his sons left Karhold. Family casualties and succession vacancies increase his influence, making every show of loyalty potentially tinged with self-interest.
